title: News
body:
06/19/2017 2:08 AM
Addition of New Worlds and Newly Designated Congested Worlds (Jun. 19)
As previously mentioned by producer and director Yoshida, there is currently a large number of players logging in to all Worlds, and the wait times for logging in are long as a result. In light of this situation, we have designated additional Congested Worlds and added additional New Worlds to the Chaos data center.

■Japan Data Center
▼Additionally designated as a Congested World
Tonberry

■Europe Data Center
▼Additionally designated as a Congested World
Odin
Cerberus

▼New World
Louisoix

*As of today, users will be able to select the Louisoix World at the World selection screen after creating a character, but the Louisoix World will not be displayed in-game at the data center selection screen. It will be added in the next HotFix.

Please see below for Character Creation Restrictions and Statuses of Congested/Preferred Worlds
http://sqex.to/6AC

We will continue to make every effort to make sure everyone can play comfortably, so we would appreciate it if users would consider using the “World Population Balancing Incentives”.
http://sqex.to/iw6

Thank you very much for your understanding and cooperation.
